name: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered
storyline: In the decaying, gothic world of Nosgoth, a land ruled by vampires and steeped in ancient corruption, this collection tells the tragic saga of Raziel. Once a proud and loyal lieutenant to the vampire lord Kain, Raziel is betrayed and cast into a swirling abyss by his own master, executed for a perceived transgression. Ages later, he is dragged back from oblivion, resurrected as a tortured, soul-devouring wraith, hollowed out and remade into something no longer quite vampire nor spirit. Consumed by a thirst for vengeance against Kain, Raziel rises through the ruins of a kingdom he no longer recognizes, hunting the master who condemned him. His pursuit carries him across shattered spectral and material realms and, in time, through the currents of history itself, where he begins to unravel dark truths about his own fate, Kain's designs, and the doomed destiny of Nosgoth.
summary:
Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered is a collection of remastered versions of Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver and Soul Reaver 2. The games follow the vampire-turned-wraith Raziel and his conflict with his former master Kain, combining exploration, combat, environmental puzzles, and the ability to shift between the Material and Spectral Realms.

The collection features higher-resolution textures, updated character and environment models, improved visual effects, an upgraded camera, new control options, a map and compass, photo mode, and the ability to switch between the original and remastered graphics. It also includes bonus materials such as concept art, lore, soundtracks, and explorable areas cut from the original Soul Reaver.
